title.narrative: Provision of food and non food items for flood disaster victims in Bo District.

description.narrative:
This project aims to provide prompt lifesaving support to the people of Bo district, Sierra Leone.
In 2015, 10 communities in three chiefdoms in the Bo district were hit with severe flooding. The few school buildings not destroyed by the floods were used as temporary shelters for the displaced people. School activities are put on hold in the affected area because school children lost school uniforms, books, and footwear. Teachers and school children have been displaced by the flooding.
Furthermore, the flooding brought health complications to the victims by exposing them to water-borne diseases, like cholera, diarrhoea and typhoid due to the absence of safe drinking water. The Peripheral Health Unit is being overwhelmed with the influx of sick people thereby leading to a shortage of drugs. Women and children suffer from malaria; children also suffer from cold, the inhabitants of these school buildings are also exposed to the dangers of crawling animals in the surrounding area. The flooding also affected livelihood activities by destroying farm land and livestock.
Support from Caritas is expected to focus on life saving support. The first course of action will include the, provision of items such as mattresses, food and Non Food Items, setting up of safe water points, bucket chlorination with chlorine aqua tabs.
As a Long term Plan, Caritas intends to support victims with the reconstruction of their family houses, provision of seed rice, farming tools, livestock, food and cash for work, improved water and Sanitisation facilities.
